[[File:Griffin-AOM.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Daughter in griffin form]]
A '''griffin''' was a mythical creature with the body of a lion and the head, wings and talons of an eagle. It had huge claws and could fly. On [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]], the griffin symbolized the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]. The [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]] could transform into a griffin.

In one panel of the [[Thuruht]] Histories, the Daughter can be seen halfway in her griffin form while bathing in the [[Pool of Knowledge]].
